text:
[LTIM.2.6.1] In v1 the re-evaluation guarantee of [LTIM.2.4] is defined for a rule
with a **single positive pattern** carrying the time-dependent condition.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_chain
idris.note: A rule whose single positive pattern carries a time-dependent test ([LTIM.2.6.1]) is re-timed at a tick; any other chain is untouched.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__tests_at
idris.note: The single-positive-pattern tests, fixed at a sample, in the form the re-time takes.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__tests_at_untimed
idris.note: No rule with a single positive pattern carrying a time-dependent `where`: nothing is re-timed.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__tests_fn
idris.note: One timed test per rule, for a rule with a single positive pattern carrying it: Rete/NetworkTick.idr's `iret_19_5__tick_chain` re-times that node and no other shape, and the fixture lowering refuses a clock read on any other shape (`where:timed-shape`) rather than run it untimed.
